title: Parking lot state machine
prompt: Implement the `Parking` nested class: constructor stores capacity and creates state; `arrive(plate)` adds the plate if not already present and not full (true/false); `depart(plate)` removes it if present; `count()` returns occupied spots.

tests.name: state machine
tests.hint: Track a used-size, scan only 0..size-1, compact on depart.
